title: 第50章 众叛亲离第49章 一人困一城
lines: 城楼之上，火山隔着熊熊火纹护罩，死死盯着城外虚空那道单薄又刺眼的身影，胸腔怒火翻涌，却只能死死压抑，每一日都过得煎熬无比。
围城的危机，远比他预想的还要致命。
火鸦崖城常住人口数十万，其中不只有征战四方的修行修士，还有尚未开智、羽翼未丰的火鸦雏鸟，以及年迈退役、无法自行捕猎的老弱族人。
雏鸟离不开专属异兽精血喂养，一旦断食便会根基损毁，彻底断送修行前路；城内低阶修士、老弱族人也需要源源不断的灵食、灵水维系生机。
可整座城池被白枫一人死死封锁，没有任何一队猎食队伍能够出城捕猎，所有外出通道尽数断绝。
城中储备一日日见底，灵粮日渐枯竭，哀嚎与焦躁渐渐弥漫整座依山巨城。
更让火山心底发凉的，是族内长老们的眼神变化。
往日里一众长老对他敬畏俯首，言听计从，可如今他神魂毒缠身，境界从圣灵跌落至圣尊五层，早已不再是火鸦羽族第一战力。
族内修为最高的几位长老，实力已然反超于他。
乱世之中，强者为尊。
他失去了绝对力量的压制，族人自然开始为自身、为整个族群的后路考量，看向他的目光，不再是敬畏，只剩下埋怨、不满与疏离。
又煎熬整整一月，火鸦崖城彻底陷入绝境。
当初身为圣灵族长，火山自负整片大荒无人敢招惹火鸦羽族，从未大批量囤积守城余粮。
在他眼里，有自己坐镇主城，根本不会有围城一说，可如今荒诞至极的现实狠狠砸在眼前：
偌大一座万族忌惮的火鸦主城，竟然被一个只穿一条裤衩的人族神游修士，活活困到弹尽粮绝。
大殿之内，压抑的气氛近乎凝固。
为首一名身披暗金鸦铠、气息浑厚达到圣尊八层的长老再也按捺不住，迈步走出队列，直面高台之上的火山，声音冰冷且直白，没有半分往日恭敬：
“火山族长，今日局面，一切祸根皆因你而起。
城外那人族修士从头到尾只为寻你复仇，与我火鸦全族无关。
你不能因为一己私仇，葬送整个火鸦一族的生路，断送万千族人的性命与未来！”
换做往日，有人敢当众忤逆自己、当众逼问问责，火山只需一念鸦火，便能将对方当场焚烧成灰。
可此刻他指尖微微颤抖，体内神魂毒时不时刺痛识海，自身修为仅有圣尊五层，眼前这名长老实力远超于他，他非但不能出手镇压，甚至连抗衡都极为勉强。
万般屈辱堵在胸口，火山面色铁青，却只能攥紧双拳，低头沉默，一言不发。
他的沉默，彻底点燃了所有长老积攒已久的不满。
一众高层长老尽数迈步走出，齐齐抬头看向高台之上的火山，厉声逼宫，声音响彻整座族长大殿：
“族长，请你出城解决恩怨！”
“不要再拖累全族，你一人之事，不该让数十万族人陪葬！”
众叛亲离，大势已去。
content_en:
On top of the city tower, the volcano stared at the thin and dazzling figure in the void outside the city through the blazing fire pattern shield. The anger surged in his chest, but he could only suppress it. Every day was extremely painful.
The crisis of the siege was far more deadly than he expected.
Fire Crow Cliff City has a permanent population of hundreds of thousands, including not only cultivators who have conquered all directions, but also fledgling Fire Crow chicks who have not yet enlightened themselves, as well as old and weak tribesmen who have retired and are unable to hunt on their own.
The chicks cannot live without the blood and essence of the special beasts. Once they go without food, their foundation will be damaged and their path to spiritual practice will be completely ruined. Low-level monks and the elderly and weak people in the city also need a steady stream of spiritual food and spiritual water to maintain their vitality.
But the entire city was blocked by Bai Feng alone. No hunting team could leave the city to hunt, and all exit routes were blocked.
The reserves in the city are running low day by day, the spiritual food is depleting day by day, and the wails and anxiety gradually permeate the entire huge city on the mountain.
What made Huo Huo feel even more chilled was the change in the eyes of the clan elders.
In the past, all the elders bowed to him in awe and obeyed his words, but now his soul is poisoned, his realm has fallen from the Holy Spirit to the fifth level of the Holy Lord, and he is no longer the top fighting force of the Fire Crow Feather Clan.
The elders with the highest cultivation level in the clan have surpassed him in strength.
乱世之中，强者为尊。
He lost the suppression of absolute power, and the tribesmen naturally began to consider the future of themselves and the entire tribe. The eyes they looked at him no longer showed awe, but only complaints, dissatisfaction and alienation.
After another whole month of suffering, Huoyaoya City was completely in dire straits.
Back then, as the leader of the Holy Spirit Clan, Huo Huo was proud that no one in the entire wilderness would dare to provoke the Fire Crow Feather Clan, and he never hoarded surplus food for city defense in large quantities.
In his eyes, with him in charge of the main city, there would be no talk of siege, but now the extremely absurd reality hit him hard:
The huge main city of Fire Crow, feared by all races, was actually trapped alive until it ran out of ammunition and food by a wandering human monk wearing only a pair of underpants.
In the main hall, the depressive atmosphere was almost solid.
The first elder who was wearing dark gold crow armor and had a strong aura reaching the eighth level of the Holy Lord could no longer hold back. He stepped out of the queue and faced the volcano on the high platform. His voice was cold and straightforward, without any respect in the past:
"Chief Huo Huo, in today's situation, all the troubles are caused by you.
The human monk outside the city was only looking for revenge on you from beginning to end, and had nothing to do with my Fire Crow clan.
You cannot ruin the survival of the entire Fire Crow clan and ruin the lives and futures of thousands of people just because of your own personal hatred! "
In the past, if someone dared to disobey him in public and demand accountability in public, the volcano could burn him to ashes on the spot with just a thought of crow fire.
But at this moment, his fingertips were trembling slightly, and the soul poison in his body stung the sea of ​​consciousness from time to time. He was only at the fifth level of the Holy Lord. The elder in front of him was far more powerful than him. Not only was he unable to suppress him, he even struggled to resist.
With so much humiliation stuck in his chest, Huo Huo's face turned livid, but he could only clench his fists, lower his head and remain silent without saying a word.
His silence completely ignited the long-standing dissatisfaction among all the elders.
一众高层长老尽数迈步走出，齐齐抬头看向高台之上的火山，厉声逼宫，声音响彻整座族长大殿：
"Clan leader, please come out of the city to settle your grievances!"
"Don't drag down the whole clan anymore. You shouldn't have hundreds of thousands of clan members buried with you for what you did alone!"
Everyone has rebelled against their relatives and left, and the situation is over.
title_en: Chapter 50: Rebellion and separation Chapter 49: One person trapped in a city
